snippet.title: Bonfire Peaks - Lost Memories parts 2+3 release trailer | Thinky Direct 2025
snippet.description:
Get ready to fan those embers and rekindle the campfires in Bonfire Peaks: Lost Memories, a 3-part DLC for the critically beloved puzzle game.

Parts 2 and 3 of the Lost Memories DLC for Bonfire Peaks release today as part of the Thinky Direct 2025!

Bonfire Peaks - Lost Memories in the Thinky Games DB:
https://thinkygames.com/games/bonfire-peaks-lost-memories/

Bonfire Peaks - Lost Memories on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2008250/Bonfire_Peaks__Lost_Memories/

More info about the Thinky Direct:
https://thinkgames.com/direct/
